description: This file contains utility functions and classes for initializing, managing, and manipulating Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) modules in PyTorch, including device mesh handling, module ignoring, and state movement.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents a device mesh used for distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: FSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Holds information about the FSDP mesh configuration.

classes.name: HSDPMeshInfo
classes.description: Holds information about the HSDP mesh configuration.

methods.name: _get_post_forward_mesh_info
methods.description: Determines the mesh info after a forward pass, possibly resharding based on input parameters.

methods.name: _init_default_fully_shard_mesh
methods.description: Initializes a default device mesh, either CUDA or CPU.

methods.name: _get_device_from_mesh
methods.description: Returns the torch.device corresponding to a given device mesh.

methods.name: _ignore_module
methods.description: Decides if a module can be ignored for fully_shard based on its buffers and parameters.

methods.name: _adjust_managed_modules
methods.description: Removes modules with all parameters ignored from the list of managed modules.

methods.name: _get_managed_modules
methods.description: Collects modules that are managed by FSDP, avoiding nested or non-composable modules.

methods.name: _verify_managed_param
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is valid for FSDP (not scalar).

methods.name: _get_managed_states
methods.description: Retrieves parameters and buffers from modules, excluding ignored ones.

methods.name: _move_states_to_device
methods.description: Moves parameters and buffers to a specified device, supporting DTensor and traceable wrappers.
